system.name: FPSAttention
system.one_liner: Training-aware co-design of FP8 quantization and structured sparsity for 3D bi-directional attention in video diffusion transformers.

content.variant_note: three sibling zoom panels (training-free quantization, training-free sparsity, fused) around one Video DiT block, the proposed one last and the only one with flames
content.argues: Training-free quantization and training-free sparsity each lose accuracy and do not combine; one training process that fuses low-precision and sparse patterns avoids this.
content.subject: A Video DiT block in the centre and three side panels showing how Q, K, V tokens and the attention grid are quantised and sparsified in each approach.

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a combination of techniques by redrawing one micro-diagram (tokens and attention grid) per variant, changing only a fill (hatched = low precision, white = skipped) and a state badge (snowflake or flame), and explain the glyphs in a framed legend; tie the panels to the shared block with dashed leader lines.
lessons.suits: Efficiency co-design papers (quantisation, sparsity, pruning, caching) that must show which tokens or weights are affected and what is trained or frozen.

evidence: our FPSAttention framework (c) integrates low-precision and sparse patterns in a single training process
Comparing previous training-free quantization (a) and training-free sparsity (b) approaches reveals substantial accuracy degradation
yielding near-zero accuracy loss and seamless deployment.

summary: FPSAttention is a training-aware co-design of FP8 quantization and structured sparsity for 3D attention in video diffusion transformers. Figure 1 puts a Video DiT block (Layer Norm, 3D Full Attention, optional Cross-Attention, FFN) in the middle and zooms into its attention with dashed leader lines. Three side panels draw the same Q, K, V token columns and a 4x4 attention grid: (a) training-free quantization with hatched low-precision tokens and snowflakes for frozen, (b) training-free sparsity with white skipped cells, and (c) the fused method with hatching and skipped cells together and flames for trainable. A framed legend explains token precision, skipped tokens and trainable versus frozen.
summary_zh: FPSAttention 联合训练 FP8 量化与稀疏。图1中间为 Video DiT 块，虚线引出三个放大图：(a) 免训练量化，(b) 免训练稀疏，(c) 融合方法；斜线为低精度，白格为跳过，雪花火焰区分冻结与可训练。
notes: The pre-screen put model-anatomy first; the lettered side panels are alternatives, so side-by-side-contrast leads here and model-anatomy covers the central block. The 162 placed bitmaps are token tiles and shadows; the emoji are colour-font glyphs counted as bitmaps. Exactly which leader line ends where is partly ambiguous: purple lines leave the 3D Full Attention box and golden lines the optional cross-attention box, both reaching the three panels.
